import { useMessage } from '@src/utils/useMessage';
/**
 * 天工分类处理器
 * 路由:
 *   /储物袋 天工 - 显示天工工具类型按钮（火焰/丹炉/炼器台）
 *   /储物袋 天工 火焰 - 显示火焰列表
 *   /储物袋 天工 火焰 2 - 显示火焰第2页
 *
 * 注意：天工物品使用独立的 user_profession_tools 表
 */

import { DEFAULT_PAGE, EMPTY_STRING, ZERO_VALUE as EMPTY_TOTAL, FIRST_ARG_INDEX, MIN_PAGE, SECOND_ARG_INDEX } from '@src/constants';
import App, { type TiangongBagCapability, type TiangongBagItem } from '@src/response-apps/storage/newBag/tiangong/app';
import { selects } from '@src/response/config';
import { addOptions, FormatGui } from '@src/utils/messageHelper';
import { Format, logger, onResponse } from 'alemonjs';
import { renderSubTabs } from '../tabs';

const itemAction = (kind: TiangongBagCapability, item: TiangongBagItem): { label: string; command: string } => {
  switch (kind) {
    case 'replace':
      return { label: '替换', command: `/替换 ${item.id}` };
    case 'unlock':
      return { label: '解锁', command: `/解锁 天工 ${item.id}` };
    case 'lock':
      return { label: '锁定', command: `/锁定 天工 ${item.id}` };
    case 'viewDetail':
      return { label: '详情', command: `/物品详情 ${item.name}` };
    default:
      throw new Error(`天工接口返回无效物品能力: ${kind}`);
  }
};

const pageAction = (kind: TiangongBagCapability, activeType: string): { label: string; command: string } => {
  switch (kind) {
    case 'lockAll':
      return { label: '一键锁定', command: `/锁定 天工 ${activeType}` };
    case 'unlockAll':
      return { label: '一键解锁', command: `/解锁 天工 ${activeType}` };
    default:
      throw new Error(`天工接口返回无效页面能力: ${kind}`);
  }
};

/**
 * 解析命令参数
 */
const parseCommand = (msg: string): { equipmentType: string | null; page: number } => {
  // 移除命令前缀和"天工"
  const args = msg.replace(/^(!|！|\/|#|＃)?(我的)?(储物袋|背包)\s+天工\s*/, EMPTY_STRING).trim();

  if (!args) {
    return { equipmentType: null, page: DEFAULT_PAGE };
  }

  const parts = args.split(/\s+/);
  let equipmentType: string | null = null;
  let page = DEFAULT_PAGE;

  // 第一个参数可能是装备类型或页码
  if (parts[FIRST_ARG_INDEX]) {
    // 如果是数字，当作页码处理
    if (!isNaN(Number(parts[FIRST_ARG_INDEX]))) {
      page = Math.max(MIN_PAGE, Number(parts[FIRST_ARG_INDEX]));
    } else {
      // 否则当作装备类型
      equipmentType = parts[FIRST_ARG_INDEX];
      // 第二个参数是页码
      if (parts[SECOND_ARG_INDEX] && !isNaN(Number(parts[SECOND_ARG_INDEX]))) {
        page = Math.max(MIN_PAGE, Number(parts[SECOND_ARG_INDEX]));
      }
    }
  }

  return { equipmentType, page };
};

const response = onResponse(selects, async e => {
  const [message] = useMessage();
  const bid = e?.UserId;
  const isPrivate = e.isPrivate ?? false;

  try {
    const uid = e.uid as number;
    const { equipmentType, page } = parseCommand(e.MessageText || EMPTY_STRING);

    const result = await App({ bid, uid, equipmentType, page });

    if (result.code !== 'OK') {
      throw new Error('查询天工工具失败，请稍后重试');
    }

    const { types, activeType, total, totalPages, items, capabilities } = result.data;
    const pageTools = items;

    const md = Format.createMarkdown();

    // 二级子类 tabs（动态，内联 markdown）
    const subTabs = types.map(t => ({ label: t, command: `/储物袋 天工 ${t}` }));

    renderSubTabs(md, subTabs);

    if (!activeType) {
      md.addText('暂无天工类型');

      void message.send(FormatGui({ isPrivate, bid, title: '', content: md }));

      return;
    }

    // 如果总数为0，显示暂无物品
    if (total === EMPTY_TOTAL) {
      md.addText('该类型暂无天工工具');

      void message.send(FormatGui({ isPrivate, bid, title: '', content: md }));

      return;
    }

    // 格式化天工工具显示，添加快捷按钮
    pageTools.forEach(item => {
      const lockIcon = item.isLocked ? '🔒' : '';

      // 基础信息和操作按钮
      md.addText(`【${item.id}】 ${lockIcon}${item.name}-${item.grade}`);

      addOptions(
        md,
        item.capabilities.map(kind => itemAction(kind, item))
      );

      md.addNewline();

      // 图片面板行
    });

    // 操作按钮放入 bar
    md.addNewline();

    void message.send(
      FormatGui({
        isPrivate,
        bid,
        title: '',
        content: md,
        nav: {
          current: page,
          total: totalPages,
          command: `/储物袋 天工 ${activeType} {page}`
        },
        footer: capabilities.map(kind => pageAction(kind, activeType))
      })
    );
  } catch (error) {
    logger.error('天工分类处理失败:', error);
    const md = Format.createMarkdown();

    md.addText('查询天工工具失败，请稍后重试');

    void message.send(FormatGui({ isPrivate, bid, title: '', content: md }));
  }
});

export default response;
